name: Queen Kailyn
source:
Queen of the Lusanti, married to [url=https://vndb.org/c165578]King Hugh[/url]. Queen Kailyn is estranged from her husband, preferring to live out her days at her personal manor in the capital. While she watches over the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url] as best she can, she is limited by the King overruling her more often than not. The Queen has managed to provide the MC with limited protection by bringing [url=https://vndb.org/c165573]Father James[/url] and the MC together.

[In game description]
